sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Go Baby Shark Go are simple yet addictive. Players control Baby Shark as he swims through the ocean, collecting starfish and fish while avoiding deadly mines. The game's controls are incredibly intuitive, allowing players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate Baby Shark through the ocean.

As you guide Baby Shark through the ocean, you'll need to avoid mines by timing your taps perfectly. If you tap too early, Baby Shark will hit the mine and lose a life. If you tap too late, Baby Shark will swim into the mine and lose a life as well. The key is to tap at the right moment, when Baby Shark is close to the mine but not too close.

The game's speed and difficulty level increase as you progress through the levels, making it increasingly challenging to collect starfish and fish while avoiding mines. However, the game's simplicity and intuitive controls make it easy to pick up and play, even for young children.
